prompts.web: WEAPON-FREE CHEST-UP BUST PORTRAIT, no hands. Final premium website hero cutout. A hyper-realistic adult MALE cyberpunk RONIN in black technical clothing, head and full broad conical hat, neck, shoulders and UPPER CHEST ONLY, crop horizontally across the middle of the chest. There is absolutely no lower torso, waist, arms, hands, weapons or weapon parts in the image. This is the DEVELOPMENT character, the only coloured accent is acid lime #C6FF36. Pose: cinematic THREE-QUARTER SIDE VIEW facing LEFT, upper torso turned slightly toward camera, head inclined forward beneath a low hat, strong neck and compact athletic shoulders. Classical Japanese shallow broad conical jingasa made of forged satin graphite titanium, subtle hammered surface and three or four discreet radial seams, not straw and not a woven hat, a very thin lime inner brim and one tiny hard white glint on the edge. Whole hat visible with generous transparent margins. Face completely concealed by deep shadow, high black fabric collar and a sleek dark opaque cheek/face shield, no eyes or skin visible, no expressive facial features, no skull mask. UNIQUE CLOTHING: an urban technical black cloak with deep layered architectural fabric folds and a rough textured raised collar, a few subtle pressure-sealed closures; NO traditional lamellar shoulder armour. Almost entirely black and charcoal, soft NEUTRAL SILVER studio fill makes fine fabric grain, precise stitching and restrained titanium hardware visible, with a controlled lime edge light behind the hat and near shoulder. Cinematic photographic AAA character art / real film costume photography, exceptional realistic material detail, austere sophisticated silhouette, high-contrast chiaroscuro, no illustration, no anime, no cartoon. Isolated genuine transparent background, no scenery, no fog backdrop, no floor, no typography, no calligraphy, no logo, no watermark. IMPORTANT: pure head-and-upper-chest BUST, do NOT show elbows, hands, belt, katana, sword, blade, scabbard, hilt, gun or any weapon silhouette, including behind the shoulders.
